_README: Single source of truth for everything the CAD doesn't contain (tape, zones, buttons, levers, pipe start spots). Units: metres. Frame: +x toward the RED side, +y toward the smokestacks, z up, floor = 0. Rectangles are [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] measured to the OUTSIDE edge of the tape (touching tape = inside). After editing, run: python3 tools/build_world.py

robot_footprint._note: robot frame: origin on the floor under the axle midpoint, +x = nose. Matches mainV2 + wheels.

lines._note: Black auto tape. Each line has an owner alliance; 'path' is a list of points, or a cubic Bezier given as 4 control points with "bezier": true. The auto line-follow bonus is awarded when an owner robot reaches within 'end_radius' of the line's last point.

list._note: red start zone -> red safe zone (crosses the blue curve)
blue start zone -> blue safe zone (crosses the red curve)

start_pipes._note: 9 pipes, standing upright, from the manual diagram (7 in from the start zone / smokestack zone).

robots._note: Placed by tools/build_world.py. The game supervisor scores every RRRobot in the world; its alliance comes from customData alliance=red/blue. Add more robots here (or paste them in Webots).
